checks.name: Screen sender rate, layer selection and privacy tests
checks.observation: Unit tests validate largest-resolution sender layer selection, summed simulcast bytes, 5-second FPS/bitrate/RTT calculations, baseline/reset behavior, bounded values, waiting/stalled states, and an exact anonymous report schema.

checks.name: Authenticated screen metrics API request

checks.observation: A fake HTTP client confirms POST /api/v1/voice/screen-metrics with the configured same-origin Origin, session cookie and only fixed report fields.

checks.name: Live sender/receiver correlation and lifecycle
checks.reason: No Android device or concurrent browser receiver was connected. Confirm OS-level stop/leave/disconnect reporting cessation and collect matching sender plus two receiver snapshots in QA-07.

privacy: The Android reporter sends only android_native, sender, a fixed state and bounded encoded_fps/bitrate_kbps/rtt_ms values. It includes no account, channel, track, SDP, ICE, IP, token or content fields. Reports are best-effort and do not affect screen sharing.
remaining: Install/run this signed build on an Android device during a live screen share and verify the latest anonymous admin sender sample alongside two receiver samples in QA-07.
